title: First Amendment to the Regulation on Investment Advisers
text:
Unofficial English Translation
Capital Market Development Authority (CMDA)
First Amendment to the Regulation on Investment Advisers
Regulation Number: 2022/R-113
(Unofficial Translation)
The following amendments are to be brought to the Regulation on Investment Advisers
(Regulation Number: 2022/R-91):
1. Section 21 of the Regulation to be amended as follows;
21. Repealed Regulation
Upon implementation of this Regulation, Regulation number 2014/R-375
(Regulation on Investment Advisers) shall be repealed.
2. This Regulation shall take effect from the date of its publication in the Gazette.
